title: Software Asset Manager
summary: Software asset managers track what software and hardware a company owns and uses, keep it within licence terms and prepare for vendor audits. They sit in the IT operations or IT procurement team and work with finance, procurement and application owners.
dailyDuties: Reconcile software installs against purchased licences
Prepare licence positions for vendor audits and true-ups
Track laptops and servers from purchase to disposal
Clean asset and CI records in the CMDB
Report compliance gaps and savings to IT and finance

skills.expectation: Reconcile installs and usage against entitlements and build the licence position for audits and true-ups
Apply Microsoft, Oracle, IBM and Adobe licence metrics such as per user, per core and sub-capacity
Track hardware from purchase to disposal, including tagging, stock and e-waste
Keep CMDB asset and CI records accurate and reconciled with discovery data
Work within ITIL request, change and asset processes
Track contracts, renewals and vendor portals with procurement
Reconcile entitlement and inventory data in Excel
Explain compliance gaps and savings to IT and finance owners
Configure SAM or HAM modules in ServiceNow
Pull install data from SCCM, Intune or Jamf
Track SaaS and cloud spend alongside licences
Work with procurement, finance and application owners

certifications.why: ITIL processes frame asset and request work
Base ServiceNow admin skills for SAM Pro or HAM Pro
Useful where the role also covers SaaS and cloud spend
